title: Project Engineering Manager
description:
**About us**

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

**The Role**

***As a Project Engineering Manager with Worley,*** you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

**Engineering Execution**

* Ensure that engineering activities undertaken on the project are in compliance with relevant legislation, codes, standards, Engineering Management System (EMS) documentation and Customer requirements as defined in the Basis of Design (BOD) and Project Execution Plan (PEP)
* Ensure the engineering systems for analysis and design used on the project are compliant with Global directives, are appropriate to the complexity and nature of the task and are used efficiently.
* Drive communication relating to technical matters.
* Ensure that Technical Integrity and Safety in Design are not being compromised to meet schedule
* Steward the design so that it meets or exceeds engineering standards regarding quality, cost, safety and performance. Innovative solutions are being encouraged.
* Promote collaboration with other functional groups and project stakeholders on engineering matters.
* Promote the use of Worley Knowledge Systems (WKS)
* Coordination of registration and approvals from required engineering legislative bodies
* Provides effective engineering status reporting including input to the project report and reviews
* Create and actions recovery plans where required
* Ensure Engineering Plan for Safe and Sustainable Engineering for Asset Lifecycle (SEAL) is prepared and implemented
* Liaison with Subject Matter Experts (SME) / Third Party Consultants as required for executing certain activities as required
* Provide Technical Interface with the Customer. Establish and maintain good working relationships with Customer teams
* Providing technical solutions to issues, quality assurance including development of departmental design standards and engineering

**Change Management**

* Ensure scope changes are identified, and management of change processes are adhered to.
* Change Management of technical issues is properly implemented and tracked

**Reviews and Workshops**

* Technical Peer Reviews are being conducted in accordance with the Location Technical Stewardship Plan.
* Identify and implement additional project Technical Peer Reviews as necessary to ensure technical integrity of the project
* Facilitate Lessons Learned and Risk Workshops - Capturing and Tracking their Implementation
* Facilitate Value Engineering Practice (VIP) Workshops - Capturing and Tracking their Implementation
* Plan and Monitor Design and Constructability Review Workshops, HAZID, HAZOP, 3D Model and SIL Reviews

**Quality**

* Through the Lead Discipline Engineers, ensure quality of the engineering work is maintained.
* Ensure the project team is working within the provisions and guidelines of EMS.
* Appropriate design checks are undertaken, and competent resources are conducting checking activities
* Recommend RCAs/Event Logging as applicable
* Ensure Quality Audit findings on the project relating to Engineering are addressed and findings and Action Requests are closed.
* Conduct Quality Awareness sessions with the team periodically

**Planning/Resourcing**

* Coordinates technical input to schedule development and approves technical component.
* Review discipline manhour estimates and consolidate into an overall engineering estimate or change request.
* Assist project management in controlling and monitoring engineering performance against budget and schedule
* Coordinate with the Location Engineering function to secure necessary project resources

**Technical Competency and Skill**

* Ensure the individual and collective engineering team competency/skills are appropriate.
* Review Skills required for a function. Identify Skill GAPs and discuss with the team for appropriate skill resourcing
* Organizing technical and work process training to address deficiencies. (e.g. in the use of EMS, engineering systems etc.)
    
  Ensure that training of less experienced personnel takes place on the project

**Digital Delivery and Data Integrity**

* Monitor implementation of Project Specific Digital Governance Plan.
* Implement Data Centric Engineer (DCE)
* Ensure data from previous stage (s) are available for conducting the subsequent stage (s)
* Ensure the integrity of all intellectual property including that owned by Worley and that used by Worley under agreed terms with the owner/provider of the information
Maintain confidentiality requirements on the project.  

**About You**

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

* A bachelor’s or master’s degree from recognized University.
* Seniority level (20 - 30 years) of relevant professional experience
* Certification / accreditations in the relevant domain
* Graduate Engineers with 20-30 years of Engineering exposure in a consultancy organization dealing in Mineral Processing / Metal Extraction/ Chemical Processing projects. Experience range can be flexible for deserving candidates.
* Candidates with experience in technical services department of a Mineral Processing / Metal Extraction/ Chemical Processing plant can also apply. However at least 10 years of engineering consultancy experience as described above will be required.
* Worked as Engineering Coordinator / Project Engineering Manager in projects for minimum 10 years managing a multidiscipline team.
* Experience in phases of engineering e.g., Concept, Basic and Detail Engineering phases
* Experience in providing visible leadership and governance in engineering delivery.
Should be open for short travel and deputation to sites / lead offices.  

**Moving forward together**

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.

And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Project Cost Controller
description:
**About the Role:**

We are seeking a commercially aware and analytical Project Executive – Cost Control to monitor project budgets, commitments, actual expenditure and cost variations. The role will work closely with project, procurement, contracts, accounts and site teams to support cost transparency, budget discipline and timely reporting throughout the project lifecycle.

**Required Skills:**

· Strong knowledge of construction BOQs, quantity take-offs, rate analysis, estimates and budgeting.

· Experience in project cost tracking, budget-versus-actual analysis, cost forecasting and variance reporting.

· Knowledge of contractor RA bills, measurement sheets, work orders, purchase orders and material reconciliation.

· Proficiency in MS Excel; knowledge of ERP / project management software is preferred.

· Ability to read civil, architectural and MEP drawings and understand specifications and scope of work.

· Good numerical, analytical, negotiation, coordination and documentation skills.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

· Assist in preparation and maintenance of project budgets, cost plans and package-wise cost estimates.

· Review BOQs, estimates, tender quantities and rate analyses for completeness and consistency.

· Maintain project cost trackers covering approved budgets, commitments, work orders, purchase orders, bills and actual expenditure.

· Monitor budget-versus-actual costs and identify cost overruns, savings, deviations and emerging financial risks.

· Coordinate with site and quantity surveying teams to verify measurements, quantities executed and contractor bills.

· Scrutinise contractor RA bills, variation claims and extra-item statements against approved scope, rates and supporting records.

· Track material consumption, wastage, reconciliation and major cost-sensitive items in coordination with site and stores teams.

· Coordinate with procurement and contracts teams to monitor commitments, comparative statements and package-wise costs.

· Prepare cost-to-complete estimates, cash-flow inputs and periodic cost forecasts for management review.

· Identify scope changes and variations; maintain a change log and assess their potential cost impact.

· Prepare monthly cost reports, dashboards and variance explanations with supporting documentation.

· Ensure cost records, approvals and commercial documents are properly maintained and updated in the designated system / ERP.

· Highlight potential cost risks promptly and support project teams in developing cost-saving measures without compromising quality or safety.
